memories.title: Project Memories
memories.description: What the builds learned about this project, kept in the shared brain (Obsidian vault)
memories.memoryDisabledDescription: Memory is turned off (BRAIN_ENABLED=false). Turn the shared brain back on in Settings → Integrations → Shared brain.
memories.notConfiguredDescription: The shared brain is created by the first build that learns something, or plugged in from Settings → Integrations → Shared brain.
memories.noMemoriesYet: No memories recorded yet. Builds, QA sessions and PR reviews write what they learn to the shared brain.
memories.noMatchingMemories: No memories match the selected filter.
memories.reasons.openaiKeyNotSet: OPENAI_API_KEY not set (required for OpenAI embeddings)
memories.reasons.googleKeyNotSet: GOOGLE_API_KEY not set (required for Google AI embeddings)
memories.reasons.voyageKeyNotSet: VOYAGE_API_KEY not set (required for Voyage AI embeddings)
memories.reasons.azureKeyNotSet: AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY not set (required for Azure OpenAI embeddings)
memories.brainHint: Every build writes what it learns to the shared brain — an Obsidian vault every agent reads. It is created on the first write; to use an existing vault or a git remote, open Settings → Integrations → Shared brain.
memories.reasons.brainNotCreated: The shared brain does not exist yet
memories.reasons.brainUnreachable: The backend could not be reached to read the shared brain
